description: April 16 birthday meaning: Aries decan 3, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 16 birthday falls in Aries, in the third decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: The April 16 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Late Aries turns philosophical on April 16. Sixteen reduces to 7, the seeker's number, and the Sun sits about twenty-six degrees into the sign under Jupiter's sub-rulership. Interpreters see a bold questioner of beliefs, someone who explores religion, philosophy or big puzzles with a fighter's appetite for getting to the bottom of things.

Astronomically, April 16 puts the Sun near 26° Aries in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Jupiter. The last ten degrees of Aries fall under Jupiter, the planet that governs Sagittarius, so this decan is usually read as the most philosophical version of the Ram. The urge to act is joined by an urge to understand why, and to go further, physically or intellectually. Astrologers tend to describe these mid-April birthdays as restless explorers who argue for principles as hotly as for themselves. Jupiter can widen the horizon and also the to-do list, so enthusiasm may outrun follow-through. At its best, this decan mixes Aries nerve with a broad, hopeful outlook that makes other people braver about their own plans.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 16
paragraphs: A birthday on the 16th reduces as 1 + 6 = 7, giving a birthday number of 7. In the compound, the 1 of the individual meets the 6 of home and responsibility, and the result is the 7's reflective, searching mind. Numerologists sometimes list 16 as a karmic debt number, linked with humility and rebuilding after the collapse of an outdated self-image. Those born on this day are often described as introspective, intuitive and capable of real personal reinvention. The day number is secondary, but in the 16 it frequently marks a rich inner life and a habit of questioning appearances.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 16 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 22 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 16 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 16 is the 106th day of the year (107th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Taurus, is usually complete within 4 days, by April 20.

By April 16 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 16 birthday are Charlie Chaplin (1889), Benedict XVI (1927) and Anatole France (1844).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 16?
faq.answer: April 16 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aries, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 16?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 16 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 2 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 16th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 16?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 16, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 16?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 16 include Charlie Chaplin (1889), Benedict XVI (1927) and Anatole France (1844). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
